subject: Permission to use UI Health logo + short blurb for GCP marketplace spotlight
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@uihealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Permission to use UI Health logo + short blurb for GCP marketplace spotlight

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — really appreciate the candid discussion about latency-sensitive chart summarization and how the Redwood Dedicated tier helped the engineering team get predictable p99s while staying under the budget guardrails.

Marketing asked if UI Health would be open to a short (one-sentence) blurb we can include on our GCP marketplace spotlight and permission to display your company logo on the listing. Example blurb our team suggested: "UI Health reduced inference latency variability and cut per-token spend through Redwood Dedicated and smart caching." If you prefer different wording, we can use whatever you approve — or you can send a one-liner we can paste in.

If this is okay, could you reply with: 1) approval to use the UI Health logo (attached are the logo guidelines we follow), and 2) a one-line quote (or your ok to use the suggested line)?

I can circulate the final quote internally for legal sign-off (minimal) and get the marketplace engineers to publish the spotlight once you sign the consent.

Attachments: redwood_logo_guidelines.pdf (branding guidelines, size/color restrictions)

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.com
